error: Names a topic without a preference.
shows: A subject is named but no preference is given
example: A pot becomes I would choose the class pot.
if_many: Add I prefer to a named planting choice.

error: Leaves the opinion topic unidentified.
shows: The opinion is about something never named
example: I like it becomes I like reading beneath this tree.
if_many: Replace it with the subject's name.

error: Interrupts the speaker.
shows: The child does not wait for a turn
example: Wait, then respond to the speaker.
if_many: Rehearse waiting for the turn card.

error: Stops after one discussion turn.
shows: The talk stops after one exchange
example: Ask where the partner found the detail, then reply.
if_many: Use a follow-up question card.

error: Omits descriptive detail after prompting.
shows: The description stops at the name
example: Tree becomes the tree shelters a bird.
if_many: Point to one source detail before describing.

error: Adds drawing unrelated to the subject.
shows: The drawing adds nothing the words are about
example: The drawing adds a resting-place detail.
if_many: Exchange stars for the text-supported shaded bench.

error: Speaks too softly for the listener to hear.
shows: The idea cannot be heard by the listener
example: The listener can repeat the stated idea.
if_many: Rehearse facing the nearby listener.

error: Leaves a questioned detail unchanged.
shows: The draft ignores the peer question
example: Add the bird the partner asked about.
if_many: Answer the question beside the draft before revising.

error: Watches digital production without contributing.
shows: The child watches but does not choose anything
example: The child chooses the line that will be recorded.
if_many: Rehearse making a wording or ordering choice.

error: Guesses a printed word from its picture.
shows: A word is guessed from its picture
example: Read hen from its sounds before matching the picture.
if_many: Cover the picture and blend the letters.

error: Omits a phoneme when spelling.
shows: A sound is left out when spelling
example: hen needs h, e and n.
if_many: Move one counter for each sound, then write.

error: Treats a long-vowel letter name as a taught spelling pattern.
shows: A long-vowel letter name is taken for a spelling pattern
example: Identify printed a for the heard long sound without reading CVCe.
if_many: Separate hearing long a from decoding a word.

error: Deletes a sound when asked to substitute it.
shows: A sound is dropped instead of swapped
example: pin to pen changes only the middle sound.
if_many: Exchange one counter rather than remove it.

error: Treats uppercase and lowercase forms as different letters.
shows: Capital and small forms are taken for different letters
example: H and h are both h.
if_many: Match the two forms to one name.

error: Treats two separated printed words as one.
shows: Two words are taken for one
example: The spaces mark separate words.
if_many: Track one spoken word per space-bounded group.

error: Matches an illustration to an unstated event.
shows: The picture shows an event the words do not tell
example: Show rain changing the watering plan, not a sunny watering scene.
if_many: Locate the actual event sentence before choosing art.

error: Adds a factual claim unsupported by the source.
shows: A claim is added that the source does not make
example: Use the documented collective planting action.
if_many: Remove the claim and select a stated detail.

error: Keeps an uncertainty without requesting clarification.
shows: The child is unsure and does not ask
example: Ask what sapling means, then confirm with the text.
if_many: Practise asking what an unfamiliar word means.

error: Does not ask a text-detail question.
shows: No question is asked about a detail
example: Ask who acts in a named sentence.
if_many: Point to a detail and turn it into a who question. Retry on a new detail.

error: Answers with a detail contradicted by the text.
shows: An answer contradicts the text
example: Use the actor or event the sentence names.
if_many: Locate the sentence before answering. Retry with a different sentence.

error: Omits the story character.
shows: The story map has no character
example: Name the person who acts.
if_many: Put an actor card beside the event. Retry with another actor.

error: Omits the story setting.
shows: The story map has no place
example: Name where the event happens.
if_many: Locate the place words. Retry with a different setting.

error: Omits the major story event.
shows: The story map has no change
example: Tell what changes.
if_many: Order two event pictures. Retry with another event.

error: Names a different topic from the information text's subject.
shows: A detail is named as the topic
example: Name what all its details concern.
if_many: Select the subject shared by the details. Retry with another topic.

error: Retells no key details.
shows: No details are retold
example: Tell two things the text says.
if_many: Select and retell two stated details. Retry with another short text.

error: Reverses an information connection.
shows: Cause and result are reversed
example: State which action produces the result.
if_many: Link an action to its stated result. Retry with a new pair.

error: Does not engage in reading toward the stated purpose.
shows: The child does not take part in the rereading
example: Join the rereading to locate its answer.
if_many: Carry a purpose card while finding the answer. Retry with a new purpose.

error: Tracks print in reverse order.
shows: Print is followed in the wrong order
example: Move left to right, top to bottom and to the next page.
if_many: Follow a finger along a new sentence. Retry on another page.

error: Treats the picture as the written form of a spoken word.
shows: A picture is taken for the printed word
example: Point to the letters representing hen.
if_many: Pair a spoken word with its printed sequence. Retry with another word.

error: Gives no name for a printed letter.
shows: A letter cannot be named
example: Name the letter in either case.
if_many: Name one letter while matching its two cases. Retry in a new order.

error: Chooses words that do not rhyme.
shows: Words with different endings are taken to rhyme
example: Sun and fun share their ending.
if_many: Compare spoken endings. Retry with a new rhyme family.

error: Treats individual phonemes as syllables.
shows: Sounds are taken for syllables
example: Rabbit has two spoken beats.
if_many: Tap each whole syllable. Retry with another two-syllable word.

error: Replaces the onset with its letter name.
shows: A letter name stands in for a sound
example: Blend /f/ with /an/, not eff with /an/.
if_many: Stretch the onset into the rime. Retry with another onset.

error: Identifies the final sound as the medial vowel.
shows: The last sound is taken for the middle vowel
example: Mop has /o/ in the middle.
if_many: Point to the middle of three sound counters. Retry with another CVC word.

error: Gives a consonant's name instead of its sound.
shows: A letter name is given for its sound
example: /m/ is the sound, em the name.
if_many: Sort name responses from sound responses. Retry with another consonant.

error: Associates a vowel sound with the wrong vowel letter.
shows: A vowel sound goes with the wrong letter
example: Long e belongs with printed e.
if_many: Match the heard sound to its vowel letter. Retry in a shuffled array.

error: Substitutes a different mapped word.
shows: A different word is read for the mapped word
example: Have is not has.
if_many: Attend to every spelling in the mapped word. Retry in a different list order.

error: Names changed letters without their sounds.
shows: Changed letters are named without their sounds
example: Pig to pit changes /g/ to /t/.
if_many: Say the sound before and after a one-letter change. Retry with a new pair.

error: Produces an unrecognizable requested letter form.
shows: A letter form cannot be read
example: Form recognizable B and b.
if_many: Trace the form, then write it independently. Retry without the model.

error: Writes a grapheme for a different sound.
shows: A letter is written for a different sound
example: M represents /m/, not b.
if_many: Say the sound while selecting its letter. Retry with another sound.

error: A letter is named where its sound is asked, or the sound where the name is asked.
shows: The name and the sound are not held apart
example: The name em for the sound of m, beside: the sound /m/
if_many: Name and sound cards side by side; the child touches the card the teacher asks for.

error: A letter is called by a look-alike, such as b for d or p for q.
shows: Two look-alike letters are not told apart
example: Calls the d a b, beside: the d with its bump on the right
if_many: Two look-alike letters on cards; trace each with a finger and say its sound.

error: Reading starts at the wrong place or goes the wrong way on the print.
shows: Print direction is not secure
example: Starts at the bottom line, beside: top left, then right, then down
if_many: Two lines of print; the child slides a finger from top left along the line, then down.

error: Letters, words or spaces are counted for one another.
shows: A word and a letter are not told apart
example: Counts the letters and says seven, beside: three words with a space between each
if_many: Three word cards laid with gaps; touch each space and say the words.

error: Rhyme is judged by the first sound, not the ending.
shows: The ending is not heard
example: Says lock and luck rhyme, beside: lock and knock end the same
if_many: Two spoken pairs; hold up a hand for the ending, not the start.

error: Beats in a word are counted by letters or sounds, not claps.
shows: A beat is not a part of a word
example: Says carrot has five, beside: car and rot are two claps
if_many: Clap a name with the child and count the claps.

error: A sound is dropped or added when words are put together or pulled apart.
shows: Not every sound is held
example: Says gb for gob, beside: g, o, b in three counters
if_many: Three counters; push one for each sound and say the word.

error: The first sound is given where the middle or last is asked.
shows: The position of a sound is not tracked
example: Says w for the middle of wax, beside: the middle is a
if_many: Three boxes in a row; the sound goes in the box the teacher names.

error: A retell leaves out the order or stops at one detail.
shows: The order of events is not held
example: Only the bow, beside: first the bow, then the magic, then the end
if_many: Three picture cards in a mix; the child lays them in order and says each.

error: A detail question is answered from the child own life, not the text.
shows: The text heard is replaced by what the child knows
example: My cat sleeps there, beside: the card says the quilt went to Zack
if_many: Hear the text again and point to the picture that answers the question.

error: A vowel is linked to the wrong sound, or its long sound to the wrong card.
shows: Short and long vowel sounds are mixed
example: Holds card i for long a, beside: long a goes with card a
if_many: Say a short word and a long word; the child holds the card for each.

error: Spelling follows letter names or leaves out a sound.
shows: A spelling does not follow each sound
example: Writes jt for jot, beside: j, o, t
if_many: Say the word slowly; one counter for each sound, then write a letter for each.

error: A word is guessed from its first letter or from the picture and not sounded out.
shows: Decoding is replaced by guessing
example: Says mud for mop, beside: m, o, p blended
if_many: Cover the picture; sound the letters left to right and blend.

error: A detail is named as the topic, or the topic is named with no detail.
shows: The topic and its details are not told apart
example: Says the tusks for the topic, beside: the whole card is about a walrus
if_many: Two cards: a whole picture and a part; the child points to the topic.

error: An answer is drawn or said about something else than the topic.
shows: The answer leaves the text
example: Draws a house, beside: a drawing of the animal on the card
if_many: Hear the card again and draw the animal it is about.

error: A one-letter change is said to change the whole word, or the changed sound is missed.
shows: The changed sound is not found
example: Says all the sounds are new, beside: only the middle sound changed
if_many: Two printed words one letter apart; point to the letter that is different.
